summary.en: Transmits muscle tension along the outer thigh.
summary.zh: 沿大腿外侧传递肌肉拉力。

detail.en: The iliotibial tract is thickened fascia lata, not a muscle. Tensor fasciae latae and gluteus maximus tension it; its distal attachment is on the lateral tibia. It has no active contraction animation [M1] [M2].
detail.zh: 髂胫束是阔筋膜的增厚部分，不是肌肉。阔筋膜张肌和臀大肌使它受张力；远端附着胫骨外侧。不为它设置主动收缩动画 [M1] [M2]。

summary.zh: 支撑肌肉附着的骨骼链。

detail.en: Supports the trunk and provides the hip sockets. The merged mesh includes both hip bones, sacrum and coccyx; attachment markers distinguish the relevant surfaces [M1].
detail.zh: 支撑躯干，提供髋臼。合并网格包含两侧髋骨、骶骨及尾骨；附着点分别落在相应骨面 [M1]。

summary.zh: 支撑肌肉附着的骨骼链。

detail.en: Links the hip to the knee. Its greater and lesser trochanters and posterior linea aspera provide distinct muscle attachments [M1].
detail.zh: 连接髋与膝。大、小转子及后方粗线提供不同的肌肉附着面 [M1]。

summary.zh: 支撑肌肉附着的骨骼链。

detail.en: Redirects the quadriceps tendon in front of the knee. The patellar ligament continues to the tibial tuberosity [M1] [M2].
detail.zh: 位于膝前，使股四头肌腱转向。髌韧带继续连接胫骨粗隆 [M1] [M2]。

summary.zh: 支撑肌肉附着的骨骼链。

detail.en: Carries the knee-to-ankle chain. Tibia and fibula are merged for display; biceps femoris inserts mainly on the fibular head, while the pes anserinus reaches medial tibia [M1].
detail.zh: 承接膝到踝的运动链。显示时合并胫腓骨；股二头肌主要止于腓骨头，鹅足则到胫骨内侧 [M1]。

summary.zh: 支撑肌肉附着的骨骼链。

detail.en: Provides the ankle and foot attachment surfaces. Heel-raise tendons reach the posterior calcaneus; tibialis anterior reaches the medial cuneiform and first metatarsal base [M1].
detail.zh: 提供踝足的附着面。提踵肌的跟腱到跟骨后面；胫骨前肌到内侧楔骨及第一跖骨底 [M1]。

summary.zh: 支撑肌肉附着的骨骼链。

detail.en: Provides context for the neighbouring psoas major. Only lumbar vertebrae are displayed; its thoracic attachment is described in the muscle sheet [M1].
detail.zh: 作为邻区腰大肌的背景。这里只显示腰椎；胸椎端的附着在肌肉卡中说明 [M1]。

summary.en: Shows the region on the reference body.
summary.zh: 显示参考人体上的本区位置。

detail.en: Locates the region on a male reference body. This low-detail shell is faded in anatomy views. Motion shows a regional joint chain, with illustrative skin weights rather than an individual body measurement.
detail.zh: 帮助在男性参考人体上找到本区。解剖视图中淡显低精度皮肤轮廓。动作只演示本区关节链，皮肤权重是示意，不能当作个人身体测量。

value.zh: 22 个肌肉部件 · 1 条筋膜束
